text: Read the following Case Study and answer the following questions. TechNova Ltd. is launching its IPO with an issue price of ₹100 per share. Before the IPO opens, shares are actively traded in the grey market at ₹150 per share. This creates excitement among investors who expect strong listing gains. However, since the grey market is unofficial and unregulated, relying solely on GMP carries risks. Questions: 1. Calculate the GMP for TechNova Ltd. 2. Why is it risky to rely only on GMP while making IPO investment decisions? (Give any three reasons) 3. Compare IPO Market vs Grey Market in terms of regulation, transparency, and investor safety.
